name: sart-studio
description: Root workspace for SART Studio projects

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:main" "npm run start:food:api" "npm run start:food:web" "npm run start:transcrib:api" "npm run start:transcrib:web" "npm run start:eco:api" "npm run start:eco:web"
scripts.start:food:api: cd sart-food/backend && cross-env PORT=3001 npm run start:dev
scripts.start:transcrib:api: cd sart-transcrib/backend && cross-env PORT=3002 npm run start:dev
scripts.start:eco:api: cd sart-eco/backend && cross-env PORT=3003 npm run start:dev
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd sart-main && npm install && cd ../sart-food/backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../../sart-transcrib/backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../../sart-eco/backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
